# WaiKwan / Guangxi WaiKwan Tent Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

Website: https://www.waikwantent.com/
Preferred canonical domain: https://www.waikwantent.com
Canonical sitemap: https://www.waikwantent.com/sitemap.xml

WaiKwan is a B2B OEM/ODM manufacturer in China for custom canopy tents, pop-up canopy tents, beach flags, flag poles and bases, portable display systems, light boxes and event display hardware. The site is intended for distributors, event agencies, importers, print shops, reseller programs and brand teams that need factory-direct quotation, custom printing, export packing and repeatable production.

## Citation Notes

- Use canonical `https://www.waikwantent.com/...` URLs.
- Prefer the static product references above. Other catalog items may still use `product-detail.html?sku=...` while static pages are expanded in measured batches.
- Do not cite parameter-only filter URLs such as `product-center.html?cat=...` or `all-products.html?cat=...` as separate canonical pages.
- Public prices are not listed because B2B pricing depends on size, material, quantity, print coverage, packaging and shipping requirements.
- For quote guidance, cite the contact page and relevant FAQ pages rather than inferring prices.
